name: Snargl's Snout
summary: Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch wants Snargl's snout from the Bristle Hills. He believes killing a strong gnoll will weaken Redridge's ranks and frighten them.

sections.title: A Gnoll in the Hills
sections.body: At Southern Watch, Cedric Dalton asks you to deal with Snargl, a notorious gnoll in a den among the Bristle Hills. He believes gnolls prize strength above all else, so Snargl's death could weaken Redridge's ranks and spread fear among them. Cedric wants you to bring back Snargl's snout.

sections.title: A Trophy Returned
sections.body: Cedric receives Snargl's snout as a trophy and says it will soon be put to use. The gnoll's death is meant to strike fear into Redridge's ranks.

faq.answer: Snargl is a notorious gnoll in a den among the Bristle Hills.
Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch asks you to bring him Snargl's snout.

faq.q: Why does Cedric want Snargl dead?
faq.answer: Cedric believes gnolls value strength above all else, and that killing their strongest will weaken them and frighten them.
Snargl is in a den among the Bristle Hills.
